name: Feature request

title: ""
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What's the underlying user problem? Who runs into it, when, and what do they do today as a workaround?

## Proposed solution

How would you solve it? Sketch the UI / API change, not the implementation. If a small change in an existing surface covers it, say so.

## Alternatives considered

What else did you weigh, and why did you rule it out?

## Milestone fit

Which roadmap milestone fits, if any? See [`planning/roadmap.md`](../../planning/roadmap.md) for the milestones and [`planning/next.md`](../../planning/next.md) for the open work, the *Refactors* and the *Unscheduled candidates*. Items in [`planning/roadmap.md`](../../planning/roadmap.md) → *Future considerations* carry a documented rationale and revisit trigger: check that your proposal is not already covered there.

## Anything else

Mockups, examples from other tools, prior community discussion, all optional.
